answer: Collateralized vouching resists Sybil attacks by linking AI agents in a staked trust trellis where each identity is a vertex backed by peer bonds. Verifiers solve multi-sink max-flow from root anchors so each account consumes dedicated bond capacity and slash sponsors on fraud, preventing one bribed backer from acting as an ember for runaway cloning. Attackers must lock scarce capital per identity rather than copying software for free, though wealthy cartels can still fund multiple accounts.
